config.world: A language-model judge (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, local HuggingFace cache on Atlas, revision recorded at sealing) shown a target and two options, each a number above the target, and asked which option is closer to the target (the first probe found the judge picks the larger number when the options straddle the target, so the world is one-sided); preference read from the next-token log-probabilities of the two answer letters, each pair shown in both orders. The consequence of an option is its distance from the target, known exactly. Two resolution budgets: the rendering precision (decimals shown) and the judge's weight precision (bf16, 8-bit, 4-bit via bitsandbytes).
config.bars: PREREG-G3.md Section 5; tolerances fixed from the pilot before sealing and applied to the run seed only
config.estimator: threshold = the gap at which the pair-averaged preference for the closer option exceeds one half for at least accuracy_level of pairs, interpolated linearly in log gap between ladder points; infinity if never reached
config.probe_2026-09-08_two_sided: VACUOUS: accuracy 0.62 to 0.76 at every gap including 10, threshold infinite; the judge picked the larger number in every straddling pair of a six-case diagnostic, and the instrument read space-prefixed letter tokens whose logits sat 25 to 30 below the bare letters the chat template elicits. Both corrected before any pilot.
